notes.title: Rising Dusk v1.0.1
notes.content:
UPDATE: Appears there was a problem with the Controller set-up menu so I've reuploaded the patch.

Hello everyone! Just a small post-launch patch to address a few small issues and add minor improvements.

Here's a list of what's been updated in this patch.

- Holding Up or Down whilst Jumping no longer affects player momentum.
- Onibaba no longer gives redundant hints, has additional hints.
- Slight change to method of getting Maneki Neko in Onibaba's Cave.
- Fixed a bug that left Total Maneki Nekos at 59 in rare cases.
- Hitting ESC/ENTER on OPTION SCREEN returns you to MAIN MENU
- Minor difficulty adjustments to boss areas.
- Fixed appearance conditions of collectable in Giri Giri Pass.

Please post in the discussion if you run into any bugs or strange occurrences in the game. However I'm unable to solve any Yokai related occurrences.

Happy non-collecting everyone,

Stobie
